caption:
Circle area: given. Circle equation: not.

The SAT reference sheet has πr² and 2πr, but not (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r². That one you memorize.

Save this for your next study session.
tiktok_caption: The circle equation isn't on the SAT reference sheet. Memorize it.

youtube.title: Is the Circle Equation on the SAT Reference Sheet?
youtube.description: The SAT reference sheet gives circle area and circumference, but not the equation of a circle, so memorize (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r².
